steps.reason: The activation restriction has no Condition or Amount spelling: no condition or amount counts lands you control that share a name with each other; SharesNameWith needs a fixed anchor object, and Controls/CountOf count a filter rather than groups of objects sharing a name with one another. The onlyIf slot takes only a Condition and has no Unsupported reading of its own, so the marker is carried here instead.
steps.text: Activate only if you control three or more lands with the same name.
